title: Average Sleep Time
statementMd:
It's been almost a week since Polycarp couldn't get rid of insomnia. And as you may already know, one week in Berland lasts $*k*$ days!

When Polycarp went to a doctor with his problem, the doctor asked him about his sleeping schedule (more specifically, the average amount of hours of sleep per week). Luckily, Polycarp kept records of sleep times for the last $*n*$ days. So now he has a sequence $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$, where $*a*_{*i*}$ is the sleep time on the $*i*$-th day.

The number of records is so large that Polycarp is unable to calculate the average value by himself. Thus he is asking you to help him with the calculations. To get the average Polycarp is going to consider $*k*$ consecutive days as a week. So there will be $*n* - *k* + 1$ weeks to take into consideration. For example, if $*k* = 2$, $*n* = 3$ and $*a* = [3, 4, 7]$, then the result is ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/2b152c6013d783a2933cb080fa7aa9f2edb5527c.png).

You should write a program which will calculate average sleep times of Polycarp over all weeks.

## Input

The first line contains two integer numbers $*n*$ and $*k*$ ($1 ≤ *k* ≤ *n* ≤ 2·10^{5}$).

The second line contains $*n*$ integer numbers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{5}$).

## Output

Output average sleeping time over all weeks.

The answer is considered to be correct if its absolute or relative error does not exceed $10^{ - 6}$. In particular, it is enough to output real number with at least 6 digits after the decimal point.

## Note

In the third example there are $*n* - *k* + 1 = 7$ weeks, so the answer is sums of all weeks divided by 7.
statementZhMd:
Polycarp 已经被失眠困扰将近一周了。正如你可能已经知道的，在 Berland，一周有 $*k*$ 天！

Polycarp 因此去看了医生，医生询问了他的睡眠作息（更准确地说，是每周的平均睡眠时长）。幸运的是，Polycarp 记录了最近 $*n*$ 天的睡眠时间。因此，他现在有一个序列 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$，其中 $*a*_{*i*}$ 表示第 $*i*$ 天的睡眠时间。

记录的数量太多了，Polycarp 无法自己计算平均值。因此，他请你帮忙完成计算。为了求出平均值，Polycarp 将连续的 $*k*$ 天视为一周。因此，需要考虑 $*n* - *k* + 1$ 个星期。例如，当 $*k* = 2$、$*n* = 3$ 且 $*a* = [3, 4, 7]$ 时，结果为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/2b152c6013d783a2933cb080fa7aa9f2edb5527c.png)。

请编写一个程序，计算 Polycarp 在所有星期中的平均睡眠时间。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*k*$（$1 ≤ *k* ≤ *n* ≤ 2·10^{5}$）。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{5}$）。

## 输出格式

输出所有星期的平均睡眠时间。

如果答案的绝对误差或相对误差不超过 $10^{ - 6}$，则认为答案正确。特别地，输出小数点后至少 6 位的实数即可。

## 说明

在第三个样例中，共有 $*n* - *k* + 1 = 7$ 个星期，因此答案是所有星期的睡眠时间总和除以 7。
